in_marathi.name: Partho
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lover of Horses
in_marathi.long_meaning: Partho हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word Partha, meaning 'lover of horses'. It is associated with the god Arjuna from the Hindu epic Mahabharata. The name is believed to symbolize courage, strength, and victory.
